base: ordinary current Core exchange; Main wire12 unchanged

control.captureParameters: Internal logical MLIR arguments, not a Native/R04 physical ABI: at most64 Source parameters and4096 capture cells, with disjoint unique BindingIds drawn from the same globally bounded4096-binding program. Their combined header cannot exceed that actual Binding set. Wire emission is unsupported; physical environment lowering must separately obey the existing256 physical argument limit.
control.completion: Explicit normal/return/throw with original source operation identity
control.finally: Bounded cloning per incoming completion; normal finalizer resumes saved completion, finalizer abrupt replaces it
control.invoke: Typed normal/result and language-exception/payload successors; actual callee and arguments evaluated once in Source order
control.module: Explicit initialization normal/exception flow, publication only after normal completion
control.termination: Fuel/depth/resource/trap/ExecutionAbort terminate the request directly and have no user-handler/finally edge

identity: Complete existing owned exception HIR and cold Source snapshot; consumer independently verifies source/type/ID/scope and actual SSA/CFG/call/handler/pending relations
scope: Compiler parse/verify/canonical only; no Runtime/VM/GC execution, wire packet or dispatch authority

types.cell: Original BindingId per dynamic region entry; reads use current value; capture operands preserve actual cell identity
types.payload: Tagged saved typed value retaining original TypeId and value/reference category; unknown catch keeps this carrier, not a hiddenoriginal
types.value: Exact aggregate value/reference, nullable or callable HIR TypeId; logical representation without physicalGC/ABI
